Sandbox_VRO_EnableEngineRebuild_tooltip: Toggle whether the Engine Rebuild action is available in-game. (If Project Summer Car or another engine repair mod is enabled, this setting does nothing)
Sandbox_VRO_UseVanillaFixingRecipes_tool: Use the original repair system that allows repairs to be done standing in place, doesn't use a welding mask, any sounds or animations.
Sandbox_VRO_DisableDiminishingRepairs_to: When enabled, repairing a part no longer increases its repair counter, so repairs never get progressively harder or less effective. (If the Old Repair System is enabled, this setting does nothing)
Sandbox_VRO_RepairFullyBrokenParts_toolt: When enabled, parts at 0 condition can be repaired, whether loose in your inventory or installed on a vehicle. Windows and tire parts are excluded and still can't be repaired once fully broken. (If the Old Repair System is enabled, this setting does nothing)
